dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures are visible along the mid-dorsal region; they exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark fur background to a high-intensity light-colored perimeter with a dark central core. The geometry ranges from near-perfect circles to slightly elongated ellipses with undulating borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity white blobs is observed in the mid-lateral and posterior regions. These clusters lack internal gradients and are concentrated most heavily towards the ventral-lateral transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' shaped annuli in the mid-dorsal area form a scalene triangle. A secondary grouping of four high-intensity blobs near the posterior-lateral area forms a roughly linear chain oriented at a 30-degree angle to the body's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct reticulated or lattice-like texture is present along the ventral margin, where high-contrast light lines intersect to form a network rather than isolated annuli or blobs.
